preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of 1 to n.
No self-loops or multiple edges are present.
The edges will form a tree, i.e., there is a unique path between any two vertices.

postconditions.expression: The output is the root vertex r
postconditions.description: The output is a single line containing '! r', where r is the root vertex of the tree.

invariants.expression: The number of queries used is at most ⌊n/2⌋
invariants.description: The number of queries used to determine the root vertex is at most half the number of vertices in the tree.
